briefings.title: Secretary Hegseth, Chairman Caine & PDO OUSW-CFO Hurst Testify Before the HAC FY 27 Budget Request
briefings.tldr: The Department of War's $1.5 trillion FY27 budget request faces intense congressional scrutiny over a controversial "divest-to-invest" aviation procurement strategy, the rising $29 billion cost of the war with Iran, and a new capital expenditure paradigm aimed at rapidly expanding the U.S. defense industrial base to counter China.

briefings.title: Secretary Hegseth and Chairman Caine Testify Before the SAC FY 27 Budget Request
briefings.tldr: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth and Joint Chiefs Chairman Gen. Dan Caine testified on the Department of War's $1.5 trillion FY27 budget request, defending the administration's military campaign in Iran and its transition to a "business model" for defense acquisitions.

briefings.title: Multi-Domain AI: The Future of Command and Control | CDAO at AIPCon 9
briefings.tldr: Project Maven has shifted from a technology-first AI approach to a "decision-centric" workflow model, leveraging the Maven Smart System to integrate disparate data feeds and collapse combat "kill chain" timelines from hours to minutes.

people.name: SecWar
people.role: Secretary of War, Department of War

briefings.tldr: Congressman James Comer and industry leaders emphasized the urgent need to modernize defense procurement by shifting away from slow, bureaucratic legacy systems toward rapid, software-defined hardware and competitive innovation to counter the technological advancements of adversaries like China.
